welcome.headline: The whole family. One door.
welcome.body: Notes, the week and the shopping list for everyone under one roof. Nobody has to remember everything alone.

signIn.returnSub: The door has been waiting for you.
signIn.inviteBody: Tap the link you were sent, or enter the code once you've created your account.
signIn.invitePending: We've kept your invitation. Sign in and your magnet goes straight onto the door.
signIn.switchPhone: New phone? Sign in the same way and everything will be there.
signIn.termsSuffix: . We never sell data about your family.

code.title: Check your email
code.inputLabel: One-time code from the email, 6 digits
code.resent: A new code is on its way.

errors.couldNotStart: Couldn't start signing in. Please try again.

errors.wrongCode: That code doesn't match, or it has expired. Try again, or ask for a new one.
errors.emailInvalid: Check that the email address is spelled right.
errors.sendFailed: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
